findings.text: blocking: the re-export lost its redundant alias (`_x as _x` became a plain `x`), so ruff reports F401 'imported but unused'; the base tree passes this check and .github/workflows/test.yml:74 runs `uv run ruff check .`, so the change reddens the lint gate.

non-blocking: replacing `_git(` with `git_output(` pushed the line past 88 characters, so `ruff format --check .` now refuses this file; it was clean at base, and .github/workflows/test.yml:77 runs that check.

blocking: the baseline_suite and after_suite log_path values join two file paths with ' .. ' instead of naming a resolvable path, and crew check --manifest refuses the record with 'does not resolve to a readable log file', so the node cannot be promoted until each arm names its logs or a digest.
blocking: the manifest carries no messages_received line, which crew check --manifest also refuses ('must say `messages_received: none`'), so the record fails its own audit on shape alone.

non-blocking: changed_paths lists 21 imas_codex/standard_names modules and 3 tests/standard_names files that the dispatch's declared write paths did not grant; the edits are all required by the done_when, so the mismatch is the dispatch's fence, not runaway scope, but the manifest's rubric.scope_discipline claim that every path is inside the granted set is inaccurate.

non-blocking: the fragment records a before-count of 17 statements / 23 occurrences / 20 distinct over 4 census measures while plan section 8 states 24 statements / 31 occurrences / 27 distinct names, and the fragment does not reconcile the two, so a reader cannot tell whether the section's 31 sites were all closed.

item_verdicts.diff: read c72201a3a, 23052c8fa and 72dfd35fc against ef218f04; c72201a3a closes every import by exporting a public alias or delegation, 23052c8fa repairs two regressions c72201a3a introduced (a NameError in release_notes and a lost monkeypatch seam in edit), and 72dfd35fc adds the 301-line evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for records of the before and after counts, the public names with their reasons, a distinct rule that passes at head and fails when a closed import is restored, and no added failure id; docs/evidence/fragments/sn-pipeline-hygiene/sph-private-import-boundaries.html gives a reason for each of the 20 names and the four chunk logs show zero added failures.
item_verdicts.goal: the dispatch goal is that no module imports another's private names; the landed change closes every private-name import between top-level modules of imas_codex/standard_names, and an independent count over the git archive at 72dfd35fc returns 0.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits c72201a3a, 23052c8fa and 72dfd35fc, changed_paths matching the diff, both suite arms carrying the same single failure id; its baseline_suite and after_suite log_path fields carry a ' .. ' range that crew check --manifest refuses, and no messages_received line is present.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared write paths were docs/evidence/fragments/sn-pipeline-hygiene/sph-private-import-boundaries.html and docs/figures/sn-pipeline-hygiene/sph-private-import-boundaries; the diff touches 21 source files and 3 test files outside them, all required by the done_when and none granted.

justifications.durability: tests/standard_names/test_package_import_boundaries.py:72 asserts `not violations` over every top-level module with no exemption set, so restoring any one closed import reddens it; negative-control.log shows exactly that at EXIT=1 and the assertion reads no value the test supplied.
justifications.evidence: head-chunk-02.log and baseline-chunk-02.log each record the same single FAILED id (tests/standard_names/test_refine_attempt_budget.py::TestEscalationFiresOnTheLastRotation::test_last_rotation_uses_the_escalation_seat[3-True]) at EXIT=1, and negative-control.log fails on one restored site at EXIT=1, so the gate asserts the done_when's measure.
justifications.fit: the bare-alias export matches an idiom already at base (imas_codex/standard_names/graph_ops.py:268 and eight more), but harmonize.py:45 trips ruff F401 and release_notes.py:136 fails ruff format --check, both run by .github/workflows/test.yml:74 and :77.
justifications.goal_fidelity: an independent AST count over the package at 72dfd35fc measures 0 private-name imports between top-level modules of imas_codex/standard_names, down from 17 statements and 23 occurrences at ef218f04.
justifications.reuse: every added name is a bare alias or a one-line delegation to its owner (imas_codex/standard_names/cascade.py:471, imas_codex/standard_names/promote.py:1483), so no capability is re-implemented; the delegations exist only to keep the tests' patch seam on the private helper.
justifications.scope_discipline: all 24 changed source and test files are implied by the goal, but none lies inside the two declared write paths, and the source run's own crew check --manifest refuses them as 'changed paths outside the write scope'.
